infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Chiron uses the camera during lessons to notice when you're frustrated or distracted, so it can switch to a different way of teaching that fits you better.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Chiron uses the microphone so you can talk with your voice tutor and practice speaking out loud.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Chiron listens to what you say so your voice tutor can understand your answers and pronunciation.
